explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/392: with A(n) the least t such that n! = a₁⋯a_t with a₁ ≤ ⋯ ≤ a_t ≤ n², is A(n) = n/2 - n/(2 log n) + o(n/log n)? Yes, by Cambie's pairing argument. The statement takes any A satisfying the IsLeast specification (monotone factorisations with largest factor ≤ n²) and asserts A(n) - n/2 + n/(2 log n) = o(n/log n), computed in ℝ. A Lean proof is linked. Faithful.
